coverage_assessment: Non-exhaustive open-web discovery: all four January weekly windows were queried; searches covered English, a Nyanja term, Bemba-oriented terms, Lusaka/Copperbelt and named provincial centers, labor/mining, health/services, markets/transit, political-process and pandemic-policy leads, and December/February boundaries. Two event leads remain pending evidence with unknown physical dates and turnout. One January travel-obstruction lead is excluded because the opened source documents no public protest; a separate 23 December gathering is outside this unit and has no reviewed evidence of January continuity. No completeness, absence, or official coding claim is made.
